o: The letter 'o'. The vowel 'o'. Forty-one letters.
(A) Preposition 'O'. (B) Paccaya 'O'. (C) 'O' (āgama-o). (D) 'O' which comes from another letter.

Upasāra/prefix 'o'. [Ava (Saṃ)] In Mog, 5. 131, the prefix 'o' is shown. In Nirutti, page- 158, the meanings of the prefix 'o' are shown thus: (1) antobhāva = the state of inside. Ocarako. Orodho. (2) adhokamma = the following verb. (3) Niggaha = oppression. Ovādho. (4) antara.
(1) Two-headed drum. (2) Permission. (3) Brahma. (4) Viṣṇu. (5) Siva deva.
